framework_lessons: Compare debt maturity with asset cash flows.
assessment: Bitcoin direction and Yellow distress are supported; the oil-production peak and adopted recession timeline failed. Large-bank bottom evidence is mixed across names. The CVS critique recognized integration risk, but its relative valuation advantage did not deliver superior three-year returns. Ripple legal scope is narrower than the summary suggests.
